#   /usr/bin/time -v (max_rss_kib, wall_s) then heaptrack (heap_peak), i265 E-cores 16-19 (wall times are E-core times; "parallel" = 4 threads).

#        soneshot/sstream = the same with DowncastFlags::none() (push_rows strip-streams at e1-15, buffers at e16+).
# Decode: dec_whole/dec_whole_mt = zenpng::decode 1 / all threads; dec_push = push_decoder into a Vec; dec_stream = streaming_decoder, rows dropped.
